import subprocess,pathlib,json,shutil
root=pathlib.Path.cwd(); rev='7ba567e44a4d30fe2013a4fc851174f76f040de6'

 dest=root/'.sites'/('deploy06-'+app)

 for f in old:

   (dest/f).unlink()

 (dest/'DEPLOYMENT.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(task='DEPLOY07',repository_commit=rev,app=app,mode='api',api_base='https://variety-configuration-applications-refine.trycloudflare.com/',fixtures=False),indent=2)+'\n')
